🇲🇽🌎 <u>"COORDINATION WITHOUT SUBORDINATION": SHEINBAUM SETS TERMS FOR US SOUTHERN COMMAND</u>

The US Southern Command just launched a joint force with 18 regional allies to fight "narcoterrorism" and migration. President Sheinbaum's answer: Mexico will coordinate where it corresponds — "coordination without subordination, defense of sovereignty and defense of our country's territoriality." Mexico has always worked with Northern Command, within its Constitution and laws. Washington can expand SouthCom's remit; Mexico's terms don't change.

🇲🇽🧪 Mexican lettuce cleared in US cyclospora outbreak — every test negative. "We took 5 whole lettuces before processing, 5 samples of chopped lettuce and water. All were negative. The hypothesis is not confirmed... the Mexican origin has not been proven." — Víctor Hugo Borja Aburto, Cofepris chief The FDA linked a US outbreak (6,358 cases, 15 states) to packer Taylor Farms in Guanajuato. Cofepris, Senasica and Epidemiology inspected the plant; all molecular tests came back negative. Mexico has 33 confirmed cases this year and no active outbreak.

🇲🇽🛢️ "The motivation is energy sovereignty." "The motivation is energy sovereignty." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on non-conventional gas Sheinbaum defended exploring non-conventional gas in Mexico: renewables come first, but dependence on imported gas must be cut with domestic production.

🇲🇽🔍 Ayotzinapa: "All my energy and will for full justice." "It has nothing to do with politics, it is part of an investigation... I will put all my energy and will into achieving full justice in the Ayotzinapa case." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on the Ayotzinapa case Former Guerrero governor Ángel Aguirre was detained in the Ayotzinapa investigation after months of FGR intelligence work, with testimony from the "verdad histórica" era and after. Sheinbaum will meet the families of the 43 students this month.

🚨🇲🇽 "No subordination, defense of sovereignty, defense of territory." "Whatever needs to be coordinated, will be coordinated. But our principles are no subordination, defense of sovereignty, and defense of territory." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on security coordination with the US Asked about coordination with US Southern Command, Sheinbaum restated the frame her government has held since day one: cooperation yes, subordination no.

🚨🇲🇽 'El Mayo' Zambada: any US role "has to be clarified." "If this violence was promoted by a US authority, it must be said, for the good of the relationship. As we have said, the relationship with the United States must be one of mutual respect and trust." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on the Zambada case Responding to former US ambassador Ken Salazar, Sheinbaum called US agencies' accounts of Zambada's transfer "very contradictory" and said possible US interference cannot be waved away as "it's over, say nothing."

🇲🇽🇵🇪 "With this, relations with Peru will be reestablished." "We will continue the defense of President Castillo, for the reasons we have laid out. They know it, the new government of Peru knows it. But it is a step. And welcome, Betssy Chávez, to Mexico." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on Peru Peru granted safe-conduct to Betssy Chávez, Pedro Castillo's former prime minister, asylee at Mexico's Lima embassy since December 2022. A Mexican Air Force plane flew her to Mexico today. Peru broke relations in 2022; Brazil guarded the embassy in between.

🇲🇽📉 Mexico's annual inflation falls to 3.12% in July. "Annual inflation in Mexico falls to 3.12 percent. We were at 3.37 in June and July came in at 3.12 percent. Very important." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, morning press conference July inflation eased from 3.37% in June and stays inside the central bank's target range. Sheinbaum credited the PASIC basic-basket price agreement (~913 pesos/week), voluntary gasoline and diesel price caps, and the tomato supply deal.
